$comment: #EXP-1655 / #EXP-1656 (owner Danny 2026-11-03): TEAM SKILLS ×4, Claude's SKILL.md as a team library. A skill = a `name` (Claude's skill-name rule: `limits.namePattern`, at most `limits.nameMax` chars), a `description` (REQUIRED: it is what makes the agent load the skill; at most `limits.descriptionMax` chars) and a markdown `body` (the SKILL.md body, at most `limits.bodyMaxBytes` UTF-8 bytes), plus `enabledByDefault`. NO files, NO versions, NO history and NO events in v1 (uniform with prompts and MCP servers). DATA: the `skills` table, unique (team, name); synced through the member-only `skills` shape WITHOUT `body` (tRPC `skills.get` is the only body read; the device running a session fetches its picks with `skills.resolveForLaunch`, keyed by X-Exp-Session-Id). PERMISSIONS (`permissions`): team OWNERS create, edit and delete (Settings › Skills, desktop + web); members read; PHONES (iOS, Android) read the list and pick, never create or edit. THE PICK: `sessions.skill_ids` (server-only) = the skills a session runs with, set by `sessions.send {skillIds}` (at most `limits.perSession`, every id in the session's team) or `sessions.configure {skillIds}`; a child started without `skillIds` inherits its parent's; an agent's runs (its conversation sessions, its trigger firings, the roots its tree starts) start with `agents.skill_ids`. SETTINGS › SKILLS (`list`): the settings-nav row `skills` (label `title`, the Agents group, right after MCP), every platform. The page = one glass group of rows sorted by name (`sortSkills`), a row = the skill's `name` + the Default pill (`list.defaultPill`, only while `enabledByDefault`) + caption = its `description` (one line, truncated at the end); owners also get `list.newButton` above the group and a row opens the SKILL PAGE; members' rows open it read-only. Empty = `list.empty` through THE EmptyState. SKILL PAGE (`page.fields` top to bottom, the prompt page's layout and controls, existing components only): `name` (mono single-line input, placeholder), `description` (multi-line input, placeholder), `body` (THE markdown editor of the prompt page, placeholder), `enabledByDefault` (a Switch, label + no subtitle), then `delete` (owners, confirms with `page.deleteConfirm` through THE Prompt). Save = `skills.create` / `skills.update`; `validateSkillForm(form)` replays `validationCases` (errors keyed by field, in field order; [] = valid): name blank after trim → errors.nameRequired, over nameMax → errors.nameTooLong, not matching namePattern → errors.nameInvalid; description blank → errors.descriptionRequired, over descriptionMax → errors.descriptionTooLong; body blank → errors.bodyRequired, over bodyMaxBytes UTF-8 bytes → errors.bodyTooLong; a server CONFLICT (the name is taken) reads errors.nameTaken inline. THE + MENU (`menuRow`, composer-menu.json gains it in the clients' PRs): the submenu row `skills` right after `mcp-servers`, surface launch, `when` temporary + `skills` (the team has a skill); its submenu = THE search list (search-list.json) of multi picker rows over the team's skills (sorted like the list; row = name, caption = description), value = the number picked (`menuValue`, none at zero, `menuValueCases`). PRESELECT (`preselectSkillIds(skills, saved)`, `preselectCases`, exactly the MCP servers' rule): the team's saved pick (per team, per client, every change saved) clamped to skills that still exist, else the `enabledByDefault` skills; list order either way. A send carries `skillIds` only while the pick is non-empty. AGENT PAGE (`agentRow`): agent-settings.json's page gains ONE row `skills`: on an agent's page the row right UNDER Device in the identity group (`agentRow.after`); on the Assistant's page the last row of `runs-on`: label `agentRow.label`, value = `agentSkillsValue(names)` (`agentValueCases`: the picked skills' names in list order through THE shared picker summary, the MCP servers picker trigger's: `a`, `a, b`, `a, b +N`; `agentRow.none` muted when nothing is picked; never a count), opening THE same multi picker; owners edit (saved by `agents.update {skillIds}`), members read. `limits` are the server's (packages/db-schema domain.ts SKILL_*). Sorting is by name in code-point order (names are [a-z0-9-], so it is the same everywhere). In the cases a string written {repeat, times} = that string repeated `times` times. TS reference src/skills.ts; the clients mirror it in their UI PRs (#EXP-1659..1661).
